parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable or disable the O&M window. Leave this parameter empty if no modification is needed.

parameters.name: PlanWindowId
parameters.description: The ID of the O&M window to modify. This parameter is required.

parameters.name: PlanWindowName
parameters.description: The name of the O&M window. Leave this parameter empty if no modification is needed.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call DescribeRegions to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: SupportMaintenanceAction
parameters.description: The supported O&M actions. Leave this parameter empty if no modification is needed.

parameters.name: TargetResource
parameters.description: The resource to which the O&M window applies. Leave this parameter empty if no modification is needed.

parameters.name: TimePeriod
parameters.description: The recurring cycle of the O&M window. Leave this parameter empty if no modification is needed.
